actions.reason: C0001 shows coherent FDR-significant RNA down-regulation of metabolic/secretory pathways with large effects, structurally coherent membership with positive boundaries and no set-level technical confounder; retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate.

C0002 has FDR-significant metabolic-up RNA and DST mutation enrichment with positive boundaries and no significant technical confounder; modest resampling stability (ARI 0.50) is a limitation but does not undermine retention for downstream validation.

C0003 shows mutually reinforcing FDR-significant immune/inflammatory RNA up-regulation and strong BAP1 enrichment with coherent structure and no set-level technical confounder; retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate.

C0004 is defined by FDR-significant universal VHL enrichment with resampling-stable structure and no significant technical confounder; reliance on the mutation modality alone is a limitation but not disqualifying for retention.

C0005 has FDR-significant PBRM1/VHL enrichment and coherent signaling-pathway RNA with compatible structure, but significant tissue-source-site and scanner associations leave a plausible technical explanation; retained with this caveat for downstream validation.
C0006 shows FDR-significant VHL/PBRM1 depletion with highly stable structure and no significant technical confounder; mutation-modality-only support is a limitation but does not preclude retention.
